title: 2022年9月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2022年9月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: Suppose your class has just finished celebrating the Teachers'Day. You are now to write a report to the university newspaper on the celebration activities organized by your class. You will have 30 minutes to write the report.You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: A Report on Teachers' Day Celebration On September 10th, our class held a warm celebration to mark Teachers' Day and to show our gratitude to all our teachers. The event took place in Classroom 305 and was attended by every student as well as three of our subject teachers. The celebration was filled with carefully prepared activities. To begin with, we decorated the classroom with balloons and handwritten cards. Then several students performed songs and a short play, while others presented flowers and small gifts. What moved everyone most was a video in which we collected our thanks to our teachers. The celebration turned out to be a great success. Our teachers were deeply touched, and some of them could hardly hold back their tears. Through this activity, we not only expressed our respect but also drew closer to one another. It was surely a Teachers' Day none of us will ever forget.
keyPoints: 导语落实who-when-what。首句「On September 10th, our class held a warm celebration to mark Teachers' Day」一句答清何时、谁、办了什么，正是导语式开门见山；次句补出地 点 Classroom 305 与参与者，落实了 outline 第一段「标题＋导语」的功能，全程一般过去时。

顺序词＋具体活动填满内容。主题句「filled with carefully prepared activities」总起，随后 用 To begin with / Then / while 把装饰教室、表演节目、献花送礼一件件列清，再用「What moved everyone most was a video」点出亮点，把庆祝活动写得具体可感，兑现了本段「用such as把活动写 具体」的方法。
效果加意义收尾。「turned out to be a great success」先给总评，再写老师落泪的反响， 最后用「not only ... but also ...」升华到表达敬意、拉近师生关系，以一句难忘作结，落实「以反响收束 升意义」。
